title.narrative: Support providing clean water and safe sanitation, and hygiene services

description.narrative: Since April 2023, Egypt has experienced an influx of Sudanese refugees seeking safety and stability. As of December 2024, over 1.2 million Sudanese have crossed into Egypt, placing substantial pressure on the country's resources and infrastructure. This sudden population increase has exacerbated existing challenges in WASH. In response to this humanitarian crisis, UNICEF Egypt has taken a leading role in coordinating and implementing WASH interventions to support both the refugee population and the host communities. As the WASH sector technical working group lead, UNICEF collaborates with various partners, including UN Agencies, Egyptian Red Crescent (ERC), and national and international NGOs. This collaborative effort aims to assess needs, develop action plans, and execute interventions that restore and enhance WASH services. One of the primary focuses of UNICEF's response is a comprehensive set of actions has been implemented to address the specific needs of refugees and host communities. This includes the provision of safe drinking water, construction and maintenance of sanitation facilities, and the establishment of effective waste management systems. The top priority for UNICEF is to promote positive hygiene behaviors. To achieve this, UNICEF will coordinate awareness-raising initiatives and activities among the refugee population, with a specific focus on distributing hygiene kits to women, girls, and boys. UNICEF will establish facilities for personal hygiene practices and reduce the risk of infectious diseases. Targeting an estimated 50,000 individuals over six months, including women, girls, and children, the project leverages CERF funding to strengthen waste management systems. Central to these interventions is the provision of clean and functional sanitation facilities, ensuring the availability of adequate toilets or latrines, and the supply of essential materials and equipment for their maintenance. These efforts aim to safeguard public health, uphold human dignity, and foster sustainable hygiene practices among the affected population.
